description: Agent Reputation: submit one reputation claim made to a buyer or principal, such as a success rate, a job count, completed jobs, an average rating, a dispute rate or an on-time rate, with its claimed figure, the time window it states, the job categories it says it leaves out (failed, partial, cancelled, refunded or disputed), the number of jobs it says it counts, who it was made to and when, together with the underlying record entry by entry: each entry’s date, outcome, rating, whether it was on time and whether it was disputed. The signed report recomputes the figure from the record over the stated window with only the named exclusions, and when it differs tries every set of unnamed job categories and then the whole history, smallest set first, so it names a figure the record does not give, jobs the claim quietly excludes with the categories and counts that reproduce it, a figure that holds only outside the stated window and a stated job count that differs, then no window, a window the record does not reach back to, undated entries and a rate or average with no job count behind it, with the fix for each. A claim against supplied evidence text is wever_claim-evidence-check, a benchmark claim against its cited source is wever_benchmark-evidence-check and an evaluation’s claims against its measured results are wever_evaluation-result-check. Verdict claim_unsupported, claim_gaps, claim_unverified or claim_supported. POST /api/reputation-claim-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-reputation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-reputation/.

base.description: How many jobs the claim says it counts.

excludes.description: What the claim says it leaves out.

made_to.description: The buyer or principal it is made to.

text.description: As made, such as 98 percent of jobs completed in the last 12 months.

value.description: The claimed figure, such as 98 for 98 percent, 0.98, 412 jobs or 4.8.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

record.description: The underlying record, entry by entry.

name: wever_reputation-claim-check
title: Reputation claim check
